value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. Fever with a stiff, painful neck and light hurting the eyes is a combination doctors want to see right away, not watch at home.
value.triage: Call 911 now if your child is drowsy, confused, hard to wake, has a seizure, or has a rash that doesn't fade when pressed. Otherwise still go to the ER now - don't wait to call 811 first.
